Scythians.name: Idanthyrsus
Scythians.note: Resisted the invasion of Darius I.
Scythians.note_zh: 抵御大流士一世的入侵。

Massagetae.name: Tomyris
Massagetae.note: Defeated Cyrus the Great according to Herodotus.
Massagetae.note_zh: 据希罗多德记载曾击败居鲁士大帝。

people.name: Anacharsis
people.known_for: Scythian prince who visited Athens and was counted by the Greeks among the wise men.
people.known_for_zh: 斯基泰王子，曾游历雅典，被希腊人视为智者之一。

people.name: Tomyris
people.known_for: Queen of the Massagetae who, Herodotus says, defeated and killed Cyrus the Great.
people.known_for_zh: 马萨格泰人的女王，据希罗多德记载曾击败并杀死居鲁士大帝。

people.name: Idanthyrsus
people.known_for: Scythian king who wore down the army of Darius I by retreating into the steppe.
people.known_for_zh: 斯基泰国王，以向草原深处退却的战术拖垮了大流士一世的大军。

people.name: Ateas
people.known_for: Scythian king who united the tribes and was killed in battle with Philip II of Macedon.
people.known_for_zh: 统一斯基泰各部落的国王，在与马其顿腓力二世的战斗中阵亡。

Bactria.name: Diodotus I
Bactria.note: Satrap who broke away from the Seleucids.
Bactria.note_zh: 脱离塞琉古王朝自立的总督。

Bactria.name: Heliocles I
Bactria.note_zh: 巴克特里亚最后一位希腊国王。

people.name: Spitamenes
people.known_for: Sogdian leader who waged a hard guerrilla war against Alexander the Great.
people.known_for_zh: 粟特首领，率众对亚历山大大帝展开艰苦的游击战。

people.name: Oxyartes
people.known_for: Bactrian noble who made peace with Alexander and became satrap of Paropamisadae.
people.known_for_zh: 巴克特里亚贵族，与亚历山大媾和，后任帕罗帕米萨代总督。

people.name: Roxana
people.known_for: Bactrian noblewoman who married Alexander the Great and bore his son Alexander IV.
people.known_for_zh: 巴克特里亚贵族女子，嫁给亚历山大大帝，生下亚历山大四世。

people.name: Clearchus of Soli
people.known_for: Student of Aristotle who set up the Delphic maxims in the Greek city of Ai-Khanoum.
people.known_for_zh: 亚里士多德的学生，在希腊城市阿伊哈努姆刻立德尔斐箴言。

people.name: Diodotus I
people.known_for: Seleucid satrap who made Bactria an independent Greek kingdom.
people.known_for_zh: 塞琉古王朝的总督，使巴克特里亚成为独立的希腊王国。

people.name: Euthydemus I
people.known_for: Greco-Bactrian king who withstood a two-year siege by Antiochus III and kept his throne.
people.known_for_zh: 巴克特里亚国王，经受安条克三世两年围攻而保住王位。

people.name: Demetrius I of Bactria
people.known_for: Greco-Bactrian king who began the Greek conquests in northwest India.
people.known_for_zh: 巴克特里亚国王，开始了希腊人对印度西北部的征服。

people.name: Eucratides I
people.known_for: Usurping Greco-Bactrian king famous for the largest gold coin of the ancient world.
people.known_for_zh: 篡位的巴克特里亚国王，以铸造古代世界最大的金币闻名。

Kushan Empire.name: Vasudeva I
Kushan Empire.note: Sent an embassy to Wei in 229.

check.n_zh: 英文维基百科：约232-247年在位。
英文维基百科：约247-265年在位。

people.name: Kujula Kadphises
people.known_for: Yuezhi chief who united the five tribes and founded the Kushan Empire.
people.known_for_zh: 大月氏贵霜部首领，统一五部翕侯，建立贵霜帝国。

check.n: Birth year unknown; only reign (c.30-80 CE) is attested, and death date varies (80-90 CE).
check.n_zh: 生年不详；仅在位年代(约30-80年)可考，卒年说法不一(80-90年)。

people.name: Huvishka
people.known_for: Kushan emperor whose coins show a remarkable variety of Greek, Iranian and Indian gods.
people.known_for_zh: 贵霜皇帝，其钱币上的希腊、伊朗和印度神祇种类之多引人注目。

people.name: Lokaksema
people.known_for: Kushan monk who first translated Mahayana sutras into Chinese at Luoyang.
people.known_for_zh: 贵霜僧人，在洛阳最早把大乘佛经译成汉文。

check.n: 147-189 are floruit dates, not birth and death years; actual birth/death unknown.
check.n_zh: 147-189年为活动年代，非生卒年；实际生卒不详。

people.name: Dharmarakṣa
people.known_for: Monk of Yuezhi descent who translated over 150 Buddhist texts, including the Lotus Sutra.
people.known_for_zh: 月氏后裔僧人，翻译佛经一百五十余部，包括《正法华经》。

Hephthalites.name: Akhshunwar
Hephthalites.note: Defeated and killed the Sasanian king Peroz I.
Hephthalites.note_zh: 击败并杀死萨珊国王卑路斯一世。

people.name: Akhshunwar
people.known_for: Hephthalite king who defeated the Sasanian king Peroz I in 484 and made Persia pay tribute.
people.known_for_zh: 嚈哒国王，484年击败萨珊国王卑路斯一世，迫使波斯纳贡。

people.name: Yujiulü Anagui
people.known_for: Last great Rouran khagan, who allied with Northern Wei and was overthrown by the rising Turks.
people.known_for_zh: 柔然最后一位有作为的可汗，与北魏结盟，后被兴起的突厥推翻。

check.n: Birth year unattested (Wikipedia gives ?-552; Wikidata 472); only death in 552 is secure.
check.n_zh: 生年无记载(维基百科作?-552，维基数据作472年)；仅552年卒确定。

people.name: An Jia
people.known_for: Sogdian community leader in China whose carved tomb shows the life of Silk Road merchants.
people.known_for_zh: 在中国担任萨保的粟特人首领，其墓葬石刻展现了丝路商人的生活。

Göktürks.name: Ilterish Qaghan
Göktürks.note: Restored the khaganate after Tang rule.
Göktürks.note_zh: 摆脱唐朝统治，复兴突厥汗国。

people.name: Istämi
people.known_for: Founder of the Western Turks, who destroyed the Hephthalites with Persia and sent envoys to Byzantium.
people.known_for_zh: 西突厥的奠基者，与波斯联手灭嚈哒，并遣使拜占庭。

people.name: Tardu
people.known_for: Western Turkic khagan who briefly claimed rule over all the Turks.
people.known_for_zh: 西突厥可汗，一度自称统领全部突厥。

people.name: Tong Yabghu Qaghan
people.known_for: Khagan at the height of Western Turkic power, who received Xuanzang and allied with Byzantium.
people.known_for_zh: 西突厥鼎盛时期的可汗，曾接待玄奘，并与拜占庭结盟。

people.name: Tonyukuk
people.known_for: Chinese-educated adviser of three khagans who helped restore the Turkic state.
people.known_for_zh: 受过汉文教育的谋臣，辅佐三代可汗，助突厥复国。

people.name: Kul Tigin
people.known_for: Turkic prince and general, whose memorial stone is a founding text of the Turkic languages.
people.known_for_zh: 突厥王子和将领，其纪念碑是突厥语文献的奠基之作。

people.name: Bilge Qaghan
people.known_for: Khagan of the Second Turkic Khaganate who made peace with Tang China.
people.known_for_zh: 后突厥汗国的可汗，与唐朝修好。

people.name: Qutayba ibn Muslim
people.known_for: Umayyad governor of Khorasan who conquered Bukhara, Samarkand and Khwarazm.
people.known_for_zh: 倭马亚王朝的呼罗珊总督，征服布哈拉、撒马尔罕和花剌子模。

people.name: Divashtich
people.known_for: Sogdian lord of Panjakent who resisted the Arabs; his archive was found on Mount Mugh.
people.known_for_zh: 片治肯特的粟特领主，抵抗阿拉伯人，其档案在穆格山被发现。

people.name: Suluk
people.known_for: Türgesh khagan who checked the Arab advance in Transoxiana for twenty years.
people.known_for_zh: 突骑施可汗，在河中地区阻挡阿拉伯人的推进达二十年。

people.name: Nasr ibn Sayyar
people.known_for: Last Umayyad governor of Khorasan, who failed to stop the Abbasid revolt.
people.known_for_zh: 倭马亚王朝最后一任呼罗珊总督，未能阻止阿拔斯革命。

people.name: Al-Muqanna
people.known_for: Veiled prophet who led a long revolt against the Abbasids in Sogdia.
people.known_for_zh: “蒙面先知”，在粟特地区领导反抗阿拔斯王朝的长期起义。

people.name: Muhammad al-Bukhari
people.known_for: Scholar from Bukhara whose collection of hadith is the most trusted in Sunni Islam.
people.known_for_zh: 布哈拉学者，他编纂的圣训集是逊尼派最权威的圣训集。

people.name: Al-Tirmidhi
people.known_for: Hadith scholar from Termez whose collection is one of the six canonical Sunni books.
people.known_for_zh: 铁尔梅兹的圣训学家，其圣训集是逊尼派六大圣训集之一。

people.name: Abu Zayd al-Balkhi
people.known_for: Geographer and physician who founded the Balkhi school of maps and wrote on mental health.
people.known_for_zh: 地理学家和医生，开创巴尔希学派地图，并论述心理健康。

people.name: Isma'il ibn Ahmad
people.known_for: Samanid amir who made Bukhara the capital of a great Persian state; his mausoleum still stands.
people.known_for_zh: 萨曼王朝埃米尔，把布哈拉建成波斯大国的都城，其陵墓保存至今。

people.name: Rudaki
people.known_for: Court poet of the Samanids, regarded as the father of classical Persian poetry.
people.known_for_zh: 萨曼王朝的宫廷诗人，被视为古典波斯诗歌之父。

people.name: Abu Mansur al-Maturidi
people.known_for: Theologian of Samarkand who founded the Maturidi school of Sunni theology.
people.known_for_zh: 撒马尔罕神学家，创立逊尼派马图里迪教义学派。

people.name: Narshakhi
people.known_for: Author of the History of Bukhara, the main source on the city before and under the Samanids.
people.known_for_zh: 《布哈拉史》的作者，该书是研究萨曼王朝前后布哈拉的主要史料。

people.name: Abu Ali Bal'ami
people.known_for: Samanid vizier who produced a Persian version of al-Tabari's history, an early classic of Persian prose.
people.known_for_zh: 萨曼王朝宰相，把塔巴里的史书改编为波斯语，是早期波斯散文经典。

people.name: Daqiqi
people.known_for: Samanid poet who began a verse Shahnameh that Ferdowsi later completed.
people.known_for_zh: 萨曼王朝诗人，开始写作韵文《列王纪》，后由菲尔多西完成。

Karkhanids.name: Nasr ibn Ali
Karkhanids.note: Took Bukhara and ended the Samanids.
Karkhanids.note_zh: 攻占布哈拉，灭萨曼王朝。

Karkhanids.name: Uthman ibn Ibrahim
Karkhanids.note: Last western Karakhanid, killed by Khwarazm.
Karkhanids.note_zh: 西喀喇汗王朝末代君主，被花剌子模所杀。

Kara Khitai Khaganate.name: Kuchlug
Kara Khitai Khaganate.note: Naiman prince who usurped the throne; killed by the Mongols.
Kara Khitai Khaganate.note_zh: 篡位的乃蛮王子，被蒙古军所杀。

people.name: Abu Nasr Mansur
people.known_for: Khwarazmian prince and mathematician who advanced spherical trigonometry and taught al-Biruni.
people.known_for_zh: 花剌子模王子和数学家，推进了球面三角学，是比鲁尼的老师。

people.name: Yusuf Balasaguni
people.known_for: Karakhanid poet from Balasagun who wrote the first great poem in a Turkic language.
people.known_for_zh: 出生于巴拉沙衮的喀喇汗王朝诗人，写出第一部突厥语长篇诗作。

people.name: Mahmud al-Kashgari
people.known_for: Karakhanid scholar who compiled the first dictionary of the Turkic languages, with a round world map.
people.known_for_zh: 喀喇汗王朝学者，编纂第一部突厥语词典，书中附有圆形世界地图。

works.title: Compendium of the Languages of the Turks

people.name: Al-Zamakhshari
people.known_for: Khwarazmian grammarian whose rational commentary on the Quran became a classic.
people.known_for_zh: 花剌子模的语法学家，其理性主义的《古兰经》注释成为经典。

people.name: Ahmad Yasawi
people.known_for: Sufi poet who spread Islam among the Turks; his mausoleum was built by Timur.
people.known_for_zh: 苏菲派诗人，在突厥人中传播伊斯兰教，其陵墓由帖木儿修建。

people.name: Yelü Dashi
people.known_for: Liao prince who led his people west and founded the Western Liao, defeating the Seljuks at Qatwan in 1141.
people.known_for_zh: 辽朝宗室，率部西迁建立西辽，1141年在卡特万之战中大败塞尔柱军队。

people.name: Rashid al-Din Vatvat
people.known_for: Court poet of the Khwarazmshahs, author of a standard book on Persian rhetoric.
people.known_for_zh: 花剌子模沙的宫廷诗人，著有波斯修辞学的标准著作。

people.name: Burhan al-Din al-Marghinani
people.known_for: Jurist of Fergana whose handbook of Hanafi law is still studied across the Muslim world.
people.known_for_zh: 费尔干纳的法学家，其哈乃斐派法学手册至今在伊斯兰世界被广泛研读。

people.name: Najm al-Din Kubra
people.known_for: Sufi master of Khwarazm who founded the Kubrawiya order and died fighting the Mongols.
people.known_for_zh: 花剌子模的苏菲派大师，创立库布拉维教团，在抗击蒙古军时殉难。

Chagatai Khanate.name: Duwa
Chagatai Khanate.note: Ruled as an ally of Kaidu until 1301.

Chagatai Khanate.name: Tughlugh Timur
Chagatai Khanate.note: Khan of Moghulistan, the eastern half of the khanate.
Chagatai Khanate.note_zh: 汗国东部蒙兀儿斯坦的汗。

people.name: Jalal al-Din Mangburni
people.known_for: Last Khwarazmshah, who fought Genghis Khan on the Indus and kept resisting for ten years.
people.known_for_zh: 花剌子模末代沙，在印度河畔与成吉思汗交战，此后坚持抵抗十年。

people.name: Mahmud Yalavach
people.known_for: Khwarazmian merchant who governed Transoxiana and later North China for the Mongols.
people.known_for_zh: 花剌子模商人，先后为蒙古治理河中地区和华北。

people.name: Masud Beg
people.known_for: Son of Yalavach who rebuilt the cities of Transoxiana after the Mongol conquest.
people.known_for_zh: 牙老瓦赤之子，在蒙古征服后重建河中地区的城市。

people.name: Sayf al-Din Bakharzi
people.known_for: Sufi master of Bukhara who won the respect of Mongol princes and helped bring them to Islam.
people.known_for_zh: 布哈拉的苏菲派大师，受到蒙古王公尊崇，推动了他们皈依伊斯兰教。

people.name: Kaidu
people.known_for: Grandson of Ögedei who ruled Central Asia and fought Kublai Khan for thirty years.
people.known_for_zh: 窝阔台之孙，统治中亚，与忽必烈对抗三十年。

people.name: Öz Beg Khan
people.known_for: Golden Horde khan under whom the Horde turned to Islam and reached its height.
people.known_for_zh: 金帐汗国的汗，在位时金帐汗国皈依伊斯兰教并达到鼎盛。

people.name: Tughlugh Timur
people.known_for: Khan of Moghulistan who converted to Islam and briefly reunited the Chagatai Khanate.
people.known_for_zh: 蒙兀儿斯坦的汗，皈依伊斯兰教，一度重新统一察合台汗国。

people.name: Baha-ud-Din Naqshband
people.known_for: Founder of the Naqshbandi Sufi order, one of the most widespread in the Muslim world.
people.known_for_zh: 纳格什班迪教团的创始人，该教团是伊斯兰世界流传最广的苏菲教团之一。

people.name: Al-Taftazani
people.known_for: Scholar of rhetoric, logic and theology whose textbooks were used in madrasas for centuries.
people.known_for_zh: 修辞学、逻辑学和神学学者，其教科书在经学院沿用数百年。

Chagatai Khanate.name_zh: 察合台汗国（蒙兀儿斯坦）

White Horde.name: Tokhtamysh
White Horde.note: United the White and Golden Hordes.

people.name: Timur
people.known_for: Conqueror who built an empire from Delhi to Anatolia and made Samarkand its glorious capital.
people.known_for_zh: 征服者，建立了从德里到安纳托利亚的帝国，把撒马尔罕建成辉煌的都城。

people.name: Ruy González de Clavijo
people.known_for: Castilian envoy whose account of his 1404 visit is a vivid picture of Timur's court.
people.known_for_zh: 卡斯蒂利亚使节，记述了1404年出使撒马尔罕的见闻，生动描绘了帖木儿宫廷。

people.name: Qāḍī Zāda al-Rūmī
people.known_for: Mathematician and astronomer who taught at Ulugh Beg's madrasa and helped run his observatory.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家和天文学家，在兀鲁伯经学院任教，协助主持天文台。

people.name: Jamshīd al-Kāshī
people.known_for: Astronomer of Ulugh Beg who computed pi to sixteen decimal places.
people.known_for_zh: 兀鲁伯的天文学家，把圆周率计算到小数点后十六位。

people.name: Ulugh Beg
people.known_for: Timurid ruler and astronomer who built a great observatory and a star catalogue of over 1,000 stars.
people.known_for_zh: 帖木儿王朝君主和天文学家，修建大型天文台，编成含一千余颗恒星的星表。

people.name: Ali Qushji
people.known_for: Astronomer of Samarkand who later carried its science to Istanbul.
people.known_for_zh: 撒马尔罕天文学家，后来把这里的科学带到伊斯坦布尔。

people.name: Khwaja Ahrar
people.known_for: Naqshbandi leader and great landowner who held strong influence over Timurid princes.
people.known_for_zh: 纳格什班迪教团领袖和大地主，对帖木儿王朝诸王影响很大。

people.name: Abu'l-Khayr Khan
people.known_for: Khan who united the Uzbek tribes of the steppe; his grandson Shaybani took the oases.
people.known_for_zh: 统一草原乌兹别克诸部的汗，其孙昔班尼后来夺取了绿洲地区。

people.name: Yunus Khan
people.known_for: Khan of Moghulistan, grandfather of Babur, who brought Tashkent under his rule.
people.known_for_zh: 蒙兀儿斯坦的汗，巴布尔的外祖父，将塔什干纳入治下。

people.name: Ali-Shir Nava'i
people.known_for: Poet and statesman of Herat who made Chagatai Turkic a great literary language.
people.known_for_zh: 赫拉特的诗人和政治家，使察合台突厥语成为重要的文学语言。

works.title: The Comparison of the Two Languages

Khiva Khanate.name: Muhammad Rahim Khan I
Khiva Khanate.name_zh: 穆罕默德·拉希姆汗一世

Khiva Khanate.name: Muhammad Rahim Khan II
Khiva Khanate.name_zh: 穆罕默德·拉希姆汗二世

people.name: Muhammad Shaybani
people.known_for: Uzbek khan who drove the Timurids from Transoxiana and founded the Shaybanid state.
people.known_for_zh: 乌兹别克的汗，把帖木儿后裔逐出河中地区，建立昔班尼王朝。

people.name: Mirza Muhammad Haidar Dughlat
people.known_for: Moghul prince and general who wrote a history of the Chagatai khans of Moghulistan.
people.known_for_zh: 蒙兀儿斯坦的王子和将领，著有记述察合台诸汗的历史。

people.name: Abdullah Khan II
people.known_for: Strongest Shaybanid ruler, who united the oases and built many caravanserais and bridges.
people.known_for_zh: 昔班尼王朝最强大的君主，统一绿洲诸地，修建许多商队客栈和桥梁。

people.name: Abu al-Ghazi Bahadur
people.known_for: Khan of Khiva who wrote histories of the Turks and Turkmens in Chagatai.
people.known_for_zh: 希瓦汗，用察合台语写成突厥人和土库曼人的历史。

people.name: Tauke Khan
people.known_for: Kazakh khan remembered for the law code known as the Seven Charters.
people.known_for_zh: 哈萨克汗，以颁布《七项法典》著称。

people.name: Babarahim Mashrab
people.known_for: Wandering Sufi poet of Namangan whose rebellious verses are still loved in Uzbekistan.
people.known_for_zh: 纳曼干的流浪苏菲派诗人，其反叛诗篇至今深受乌兹别克人喜爱。

people.name: Bukhar Zhyrau
people.known_for: Kazakh bard and adviser of Ablai Khan whose songs urged unity against the Dzungars.
people.known_for_zh: 哈萨克诗人歌手，阿布赉汗的谋士，其诗歌号召团结抗击准噶尔。

people.name: Ablai Khan
people.known_for: Kazakh khan who led the fight against the Dzungars and balanced between Russia and Qing China.
people.known_for_zh: 哈萨克汗，领导抗击准噶尔的战争，在俄国与清朝之间周旋。

people.name: Magtymguly Pyragy
people.known_for: National poet of the Turkmens who wrote in the people's own language.
people.known_for_zh: 土库曼民族诗人，用土库曼人自己的语言写诗。

people.name: Nodira
people.known_for: Poet and wife of the khan of Kokand who ruled as regent and was killed by the emir of Bukhara.
people.known_for_zh: 浩罕汗的妃子和诗人，曾摄政，被布哈拉埃米尔杀害。

people.name: Kenesary Kasymov
people.known_for: Last Kazakh khan, who led a ten-year revolt against Russian rule.
people.known_for_zh: 哈萨克最后一位汗，领导反抗俄国统治的十年起义。

people.name: Chokan Valikhanov
people.known_for: Kazakh scholar and Russian officer who secretly travelled to Kashgar and studied steppe history.
people.known_for_zh: 哈萨克学者和俄国军官，曾秘密前往喀什噶尔，研究草原历史。

Khiva Khanate.name: Muhammad Rahim Khan II
Khiva Khanate.name_zh: 穆罕默德·拉希姆汗二世

people.name: Ahmad Donish
people.known_for: Bukharan scholar and diplomat who called for reform after visiting Russia.
people.known_for_zh: 布哈拉学者和外交官，出访俄国后呼吁改革。

people.name: Konstantin von Kaufman
people.known_for: First governor-general of Russian Turkestan, who conquered Samarkand and Khiva.
people.known_for_zh: 俄属突厥斯坦首任总督，征服撒马尔罕和希瓦。

people.name: Nikolay Przhevalsky
people.known_for: Russian explorer of Central Asia who described the wild horse named after him.
people.known_for_zh: 俄国中亚探险家，记录了以他名字命名的野马。

people.name: Mikhail Skobelev
people.known_for: Russian general who took Kokand and Geok Tepe, completing the conquest of the Turkmens.
people.known_for_zh: 俄国将领，攻占浩罕和格奥克捷佩，完成对土库曼人的征服。

people.name: Ibrahim Altynsarin
people.known_for: Kazakh educator who opened schools and wrote textbooks in Kazakh.
people.known_for_zh: 哈萨克教育家，创办学校，用哈萨克语编写教科书。

people.name: Muhammad Rahim Khan II
people.name_zh: 穆罕默德·拉希姆汗二世
people.known_for: Khan of Khiva under Russian protection, a poet under the name Feruz and patron of the arts.
people.known_for_zh: 受俄国保护的希瓦汗，以“菲鲁兹”为笔名写诗，并资助文艺。

people.name: Abai Qunanbaiuly
people.known_for: Founder of written Kazakh literature, poet and translator of Pushkin and Lermontov.
people.known_for_zh: 哈萨克书面文学的奠基人，诗人，翻译了普希金和莱蒙托夫的作品。

people.name: Alikhan Bukeikhanov
people.known_for: Kazakh politician who led the Alash party and the short-lived Alash autonomy of 1917.
people.known_for_zh: 哈萨克政治家，领导阿拉什党和1917年短暂存在的阿拉什自治政府。

people.name: Amangeldy Imanov
people.known_for: Leader of the Kazakh uprising of 1916 against wartime labour conscription.
people.known_for_zh: 1916年哈萨克人反抗战时劳役征发起义的领袖。

people.name: Mahmudkhodja Behbudiy
people.known_for: Leader of the Jadid reform movement who wrote the first modern Uzbek play.
people.known_for_zh: 扎吉德改革运动的领袖，写出第一部现代乌兹别克语剧本。

Kazakh SSR.name_zh: 哈萨克苏维埃社会主义共和国

Uzbek SSR.name_zh: 乌兹别克苏维埃社会主义共和国

USSR.name: Vladimir Lenin
USSR.rank: Chairman of the Council of People's Commissars

Kazakh SSR.name: Nursultan Nazarbayev
Kazakh SSR.name_zh: 努尔苏丹·纳扎尔巴耶夫

people.name: Sadriddin Ayni
people.known_for: Writer and scholar regarded as the founder of modern Tajik literature.
people.known_for_zh: 作家和学者，被视为现代塔吉克文学的奠基人。

people.name: Abdurauf Fitrat
people.name_zh: 阿卜杜拉乌夫·菲特拉特
people.known_for: Jadid reformer, playwright and scholar of Uzbek literature, executed in Stalin's purges.
people.known_for_zh: 扎吉德改革者、剧作家和乌兹别克文学学者，在斯大林大清洗中被处决。

people.name: Akhmet Baitursynov
people.name_zh: 阿合买提·拜图尔森诺夫
people.known_for: Kazakh linguist and poet who created a Kazakh alphabet and edited the newspaper Kazakh.
people.known_for_zh: 哈萨克语言学家和诗人，创制哈萨克文字母，主编《哈萨克报》。

people.name: Hamza Hakimzade Niyazi
people.known_for: Uzbek poet and playwright, a founder of Soviet Uzbek literature, killed in Shohimardon.
people.known_for_zh: 乌兹别克诗人和剧作家，苏联乌兹别克文学的奠基人之一，在沙希马尔丹被杀。

people.name: Abdulla Qodiriy
people.known_for: Author of the first Uzbek novel, executed in the purges of 1938.
people.known_for_zh: 第一部乌兹别克语长篇小说的作者，1938年在大清洗中被处决。

people.name: Mukhtar Auezov
people.known_for: Kazakh writer whose epic novel about the poet Abai is a classic of Kazakh literature.
people.known_for_zh: 哈萨克作家，其描写诗人阿拜的长篇史诗小说是哈萨克文学经典。

people.name: Kanysh Satbayev
people.known_for: Geologist who found the Zhezkazgan copper deposits and founded the Kazakh Academy of Sciences.
people.known_for_zh: 地质学家，发现杰兹卡兹甘铜矿，创建哈萨克科学院。

people.name: G'afur G'ulom
people.known_for: Uzbek poet and novelist known for his war poems and the comic tale The Mischievous Boy.
people.known_for_zh: 乌兹别克诗人和小说家，以战争诗篇和幽默小说《调皮鬼》著称。

people.name: Mirzo Tursunzoda
people.known_for: Tajik national poet who led the Tajik Writers' Union for decades.
people.known_for_zh: 塔吉克民族诗人，长期领导塔吉克作家协会。

people.name: Sharof Rashidov
people.known_for: Party leader of Uzbekistan for 24 years, later linked to the cotton scandal.
people.known_for_zh: 领导乌兹别克斯坦共产党24年，后来卷入“棉花案”。

people.name: Dinmukhamed Kunaev
people.known_for: Kazakh party leader whose removal in 1986 set off the Jeltoqsan protests in Almaty.
people.known_for_zh: 哈萨克共产党领导人，1986年被撤职引发阿拉木图“十二月事件”。

people.name: Chinghiz Aitmatov
people.known_for: Kyrgyz novelist whose stories of village life were read across the Soviet Union and in China.
people.known_for_zh: 吉尔吉斯小说家，其描写乡村生活的作品在苏联和中国广为流传。

works.title: The Day Lasts More Than a Hundred Years

Kazakhstan.name_zh: 努尔苏丹·纳扎尔巴耶夫

Kazakhstan.name_zh: 卡瑟姆-若马尔特·托卡耶夫

Uzbekistan.name_zh: 沙夫卡特·米尔济约耶夫

Turkmenistan.name_zh: 萨帕尔穆拉特·尼亚佐夫

Turkmenistan.name_zh: 古尔班古力·别尔德穆哈梅多夫

Turkmenistan.name: Serdar Berdimuhamedow
Turkmenistan.name_zh: 谢尔达尔·别尔德穆哈梅多夫

people.name: Islam Karimov
people.known_for: First president of independent Uzbekistan, who ruled with a firm hand for 25 years.
people.known_for_zh: 独立后乌兹别克斯坦的首任总统，铁腕执政25年。

people.name: Saparmurat Niyazov
people.name_zh: 萨帕尔穆拉特·尼亚佐夫
people.known_for: First president of Turkmenistan, who built an extreme personality cult as Turkmenbashi.
people.known_for_zh: 土库曼斯坦首任总统，以“土库曼巴什”之名大搞个人崇拜。

people.name: Rahmon Nabiyev
people.known_for: First president of independent Tajikistan, forced out in 1992 as the civil war began.
people.known_for_zh: 独立后塔吉克斯坦首任总统，1992年内战爆发时被迫下台。

people.name: Abdulla Oripov
people.known_for: Uzbek poet who wrote the words of the national anthem of independent Uzbekistan.
people.known_for_zh: 乌兹别克诗人，为独立后的乌兹别克斯坦国歌作词。

people.name: Erkin Vohidov
people.known_for: Uzbek poet and translator of Goethe's Faust, who also sat in the parliament after independence.
people.known_for_zh: 乌兹别克诗人，翻译了歌德的《浮士德》，独立后曾任议员。

people.name: Batyrkhan Shukenov
people.known_for: Kazakh singer and saxophonist, one of the best-loved pop musicians of independent Kazakhstan.
people.known_for_zh: 哈萨克歌手和萨克斯手，是独立后哈萨克斯坦最受喜爱的流行音乐人之一。
